# Paths cited in docs/design or docs/spec that do not exist, each with why and when the entry goes.
# Format: <path, or folder/ for everything under it> | <reason and removal condition>
#
# Ahead of the build: the Playbook step that creates the path removes the entry.
apps/desktop/capabilities/main.json | Tauri capability file; remove with the desktop capability step
apps/server/ | the server program; remove with its Playbook step
crates/ordin-dictation/swift | Swift helper of the dictation service; remove with its Playbook step
crates/ordin-source-access | Playbook step for Source Access not run; remove with it
deploy/argocd/application.yaml | server deployment; remove with its Playbook step
deploy/container/Containerfile | server image; remove with its Playbook step
docs/CODEOWNERS | named by the Catalogue Service spec; remove when the file is added
docs/runbooks | no runbook written yet; remove with the first one
memory/src/freshness | spec says on purpose it is not built; remove if it is built
memory/src/grants | spec says on purpose it is not built; remove if it is built
apps/desktop/catalogue | made by release-build and ignored by git; stays (PB-REL-7)
apps/desktop/catalogue/ | made by release-build and ignored by git, everything under it included; stays (PB-REL-7)
apps/desktop/windows-runtime | filled by a Windows release-build and ignored by git; stays (PB-REL-25)
#
# Not paths in this repository: the text names a place elsewhere. These stay.
.claude/ | a folder in a person's workspace, written by the installers
../../x | an example of a refused path in the Agent Loader spec
sandbox/audit-hmac-key | a secret name, not a file
memory/migrations/0001 | shorthand for the first migration of a numbered range
docs/concept/ | removed folder, named only in the append-only changelog's history
docs/concept | as above
.git/ | a folder inside a person's working copy, read by the Workspace Service; absent in a worktree
target/local-build/windows | where make local-build-windows-remote puts the installer it brings back; build output, ignored by git; stays (PB-REL-30)
